title: x-recipe
description: Marks an Arazzo workflow as a setup recipe and provides recipe-specific metadata. Presence of this extension is the recipe/scenario discriminator — there is no separate x-category field. See Arazzo Handbook §7.

purpose.description: What the recipe provisions fixtures for

extends.description: Single-inheritance composition chain of recipe file stems. Each entry extends the previous. Max chain depth: 6.

idempotent.description: Whether running the recipe twice produces the same result. Default: true

estimatedDurationMs.description: Estimated execution time in milliseconds (informational, for test scheduling)

scope.description: Lifetime of the fixture. Default: scenario. Session scope deferred to Phase 5+.
